questions.question: What does chapter 12 address?
options: Purification of a woman after childbirth
Treatment of an infectious and spreading skin disease
questions.answer: Purification of a woman after childbirth

questions.question: What could a poor woman bring if she could not afford a lamb?
options: A young goat from the flock
A silver coin for the priest

questions.question: A woman was to bring an offering after the days of her purification.
